title: Afzal Khan v. State of U.P.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; recovery withdrawn; hearing and reasoned order in eight weeks.
headnote: On the licensee's withdrawal of the recovery certificate and issue of a fresh hearing notice, the writ seeking final assessment under clauses 6.8 and 8.1 was disposed with a direction to hear the consumer and pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within eight weeks.
facts: Afzal Khan invoked Article 226 seeking a mandamus to complete final assessment and pass a final order under clauses 6.8 and 8.1 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, on the strength of an order dated 28 January 2025, and certiorari to quash a recovery certificate dated 15 May 2024. Counsel for the distribution licensee told the Court that the impugned recovery certificate had been withdrawn and that a fresh notice, fixing a date of hearing, had been issued to the petitioner.

holding_units.holding: Where the licensee withdraws the recovery certificate and issues a fresh notice fixing a hearing, a writ seeking final assessment under clauses 6.8 and 8.1 is disposed of with a direction to grant the consumer an opportunity of hearing and thereafter pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within eight weeks.

not_decided.point: Merits of final assessment under clauses 6.8 or 8.1, and validity of the recovery certificate
not_decided.note: Recovery was withdrawn by the licensee; the Court directed hearing and a reasoned order without choosing between the clauses or deciding the bill.
